name: Teardown runs when the journey fails
title: SC-13-07-04 Teardown runs when the journey fails
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a site in state F5
When a step of the journey raises an error
Then the redacted site row counts and route/status network evidence are saved first
And the teardown still removes the site
